categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in two segments: biological feed production using fermentation of distillery by-products (mainly baijiu distiller's grains) and inorganic solid waste treatment services including river and lake sludge, engineering mud, and industrial residue treatment. The biological feed segment focuses on producing functional bio-fermented feed products for animal husbandry, while the inorganic solid waste segment provides environmental treatment and resource utilization services.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: Core technologies include proprietary organic residue microbial solid-state fermentation technology and integrated sludge dehydration and solidification technology. The company applies advanced biotechnologies such as synthetic biology, enzyme engineering, and microbial fermentation to convert high-moisture distillery by-products into functional bio-feed. It also uses patented chemical and mechanical processes for inorganic waste treatment, including HEC composite salt solidification and CO2 neutralization for wastewater discharge compliance.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are large-scale feed processing enterprises and animal husbandry companies, especially in the pig, poultry, and ruminant sectors. The company serves the baijiu liquor industry by utilizing its by-products and downstream feed and livestock markets. Geographically, customers are mainly in China, with significant presence in regions producing sauce-flavor, strong-flavor, and rich-flavor baijiu. The inorganic waste treatment services cater to municipal and industrial clients involved in environmental remediation projects.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with production and service facilities located in provinces such as Sichuan, Guizhou, Anhui, Hubei, Jiangsu, and Hunan. Key production bases include multiple bio-feed factories in Luzhou, Bijie, Zunyi, Bozhou, Suqian, and Xiangxi. The company also has environmental service centers in Wuhan and Shaoxing. Its market coverage spans major livestock and feed production regions across eastern, central, southern, southwestern, and northwestern China.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates midstream and downstream in the supply chain. It collects raw materials (distillery by-products) from upstream baijiu producers and processes them into bio-fermented feed products sold to downstream feed manufacturers and livestock farms. In inorganic waste treatment, it provides environmental remediation services and sells solidification materials, positioning itself as a service provider and resource recycler within the waste management supply chain.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include deepening the integration of biological manufacturing with environmental protection, expanding bio-feed production capacity, and advancing synthetic biology applications. The company emphasizes R&D in enzyme engineering, microbial strain optimization, and fermentation process innovation to enhance product functionality and cost efficiency. It also focuses on expanding the application of its technologies to new feed raw materials, bio-based materials, cosmetics, and health food sectors, supported by extensive industry-academic collaborations.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through product sales of bio-fermented feed and service fees from inorganic solid waste treatment. The bio-feed segment sells functional feed products based on contractually agreed prices and volumes to feed processors and livestock enterprises. The waste treatment segment charges fees based on the volume and type of waste processed, including sludge and mud dehydration and solidification services. The company also earns income from selling core solidification materials and government subsidies.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading player and technology pioneer in the resource utilization of baijiu distillery by-products and high-moisture inorganic waste treatment in China. It holds a dominant market position with proprietary technologies and extensive production capacity. While the inorganic waste treatment market is fragmented with few specialized competitors, the bio-feed segment faces emerging competition as the industry grows. The company maintains competitive advantages through patented technologies, government recognition, and strategic partnerships with major liquor producers.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 277.6 million, a 20.9% decrease from the previous year, with net loss attributable to shareholders of RMB 56.55 million. The bio-feed business showed growth with sales volume increasing by 20.7% and revenue by 10.2%, while inorganic waste treatment revenue declined significantly. Total assets grew by 8.55% to RMB 1.73 billion, and net assets attributable to shareholders decreased by 6.97% to RMB 834.4 million. R&D investment increased by 44.7%, accounting for 7.12% of revenue.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company offers unique value by converting high-moisture distillery by-products into functional bio-fermented feed that combines nutritional and immunological benefits, reducing reliance on traditional feed ingredients like soybean meal and corn. Its proprietary fermentation technology enhances feed digestibility and animal health, supporting sustainable and eco-friendly livestock production. Additionally, its integrated inorganic waste treatment technologies provide efficient, low-footprint solutions for environmental remediation, aligning with national green and circular economy policies.
